scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
